caption: "gable steveson" — 200,000+ searches this week. Swipe for 10 things most people don't know about the Olympic champion knocked out in 12 seconds.
Why: at UFC 331 on September 19, Sean Sharaf knocked out Gable Steveson with a left hand 12 seconds into round one, the third-fastest knockout in UFC history. Steveson was a 25-to-1 favourite.

What most people don't know: Steveson is named after wrestling legend Dan Gable. He won Olympic gold with a takedown in the final seconds, went 85-2 in college, signed with WWE as a student, spent a summer with the Buffalo Bills, and had four pro fights before Saturday.
Very simply put: gold medal to 12-second knockout in five years.
